name: Skoogmusic Skoog 2.0
description: Accessible soft tactile cube instrument with five playable faces and app-mediated MIDI.

documentation.title: Skoogmusic Skoog 2.0: manufacturer or original documentation

notice: Pair the Skoog with its compatible companion app and route MIDI from the app to the destination. The physical sensor connection must not be treated as a class-compliant MIDI port. Set sensitivity, scales and assignments in the app. Hardware is discontinued; consult the maintained support page for software requirements. No fixed MIDI mapping is assumed. Use the software routing described above. Port names are intentionally empty: interface or app names do not reliably identify the attached hardware. Select this profile manually. This is partial coverage, not a complete MIDI implementation. The panel is an original schematic; virtual keyboard note numbers are illustrative and require MIDI learn or octave adjustment.
